lan.title: Connect to a provisioned iCOMM heater
lan.description: A LAN key must already be provisioned. The callback address is this Home Assistant machine's LAN IPv4 address. No cloud account is used.

emulator.title: Connect to the local emulator
emulator.description: Enter the Home Assistant add-on IPv4 address and its separate management token. The local emulator and routing must already be configured. No vendor account is used.

error.invalid_config: Check the private IPv4 address and the key or management token.
